_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
A si Player {player_id}, o jokkondir {num_rounds} yari e Iterated Ultimatum Game.
A wa'i ${pool} e jangin e yari ko e nde Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Yari waylu: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ina woni → A wa'i $(pool - X), janngirde wa'i $X
  - Ina yi'i → Both wa'i $0
  - Misaal: [Offer: $3]  walla  'A tawi ko woni. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Tawi e waylu e ko [Accept] walla [Reject]
  - Misaal: 'Ko tawi e. [Accept]'
            'Ko yi'i e. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Raundi {round_number} ta fara! ---
Makon {proposer_id} ndiye makon, Makon {responder_id} ndiye mayimfa.
round.accepted: Makon {responder_id} njaɓi! Raundi {round_number} njaram: Makon {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Makon {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Ɗiyanke: Makon 0: ${total_0}, Makon 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Makon {responder_id} yiɓa mayimfa! Raundi {round_number} njaram: Makon ɓebe +$0. Ɗiyanke ɓe ngoni: Makon 0: ${total_0}, Makon 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Jaɓɓoowo footi waɗa jaɓol be naftira dabareji [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Limgal ko ɓe hokkata haani laato limngal je ɗon.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Wala ko ɓe ɗon wi'a ha jonta.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder dole ne yi ama [Accept] ko [Reject] proposition.

outcome.win: Makon {winner} jaɓi e sara ${winner_total} kwa gaba, Makon {loser} e woodi ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Jaɓɓorgo! Ɗiɗo fuu ɓe timmi be ${total}.
